save.hint: The passage is all you need. Everything else is optional.

thoughts.title: My thoughts
thoughts.empty: No thought added yet. You don't have to add one.
thoughts.placeholder: What did this passage mean to you?

delete.title: Delete this passage?
delete.body: Thoughts and tags go with it. Practices stay.

list.title: Books
list.empty: No books yet. You can save passages without a book.

detail.empty: Nothing saved from this book yet.

delete.title: Delete this book?
delete.body: Your {{count}} saved passages will stay. Only their link to this book will be removed.

review.prompt: Take a moment to recall it.
review.title: Today’s review

language.title: Language
language.hint: Saved passages and your thoughts stay in the language you wrote them in.

notice.proxy: For AI analysis, the passage, your thought, book title, page and language are sent through the Re:Read server to the AI provider. Re:Read does not store this content; only usage counts are retained.

backup.title: Backup
backup.intro: Your passages and thoughts live only on this device. Export a file and you can bring them back on a new one.
backup.caution: The exported file holds everything you saved, unencrypted. Keep it somewhere safe. The file is never sent to a server.
backup.shareUnavailable: File sharing is not available on this device.

import.replaceConfirmTitle: Replace what is on this device?
import.replaceConfirmBody: Everything on this device will become the file's contents. This cannot be undone.
import.failed: Could not import. Nothing on this device changed.
import.invalidFile: This is not a backup file, or it is damaged.
import.newerApp: This file was made by a newer version. Update the app, then import it.

reminder.title: Review reminder
reminder.hint: Only on days with passages to revisit. Once a day.
reminder.denied: Notifications are turned off in your device settings.
